Opens the BottomNav@1.2.0 preview harness (story=mobile-primary) at top level, focuses the first navigation item, presses Tab, and asserts focus advances to a later item that is still inside the nav element. Proves BottomNav items are keyboard-reachable in sequence rather than only pointer-operable.

Opens the DrawerShell@1.0.0 preview harness (story=full-open) at top level and proves the focus trap: after focusing the in-panel close button and pressing Tab, keyboard focus stays inside the role=dialog panel instead of leaking to the backdrop or document body. This is the exact failure class the DrawerShell pilot exposed that screenshot-diffs cannot catch. The paired calibration bas/calibration/drawershell-focus-trap-broken.json runs the same assertion against DrawerShell@0.1.0 (which has no useFocusTrap) and must fail.

Opens the Select@1.1.0 preview harness (story=selected, defaultValue=native) at top level, focuses the combobox, presses ArrowDown, and asserts the selected value advances from 'native' to 'compatible'. Proves the Select component honours keyboard option navigation, not merely that it renders a combobox.
Opens the seeded StatusBadge Preview with an explicit story query, then reloads the same deep link and proves the requested story remains the rendered active card.

Navigates to the seeded StatusBadge component workbench at desktop width and proves its selected state canvas, controls, Appearance, and Viewport surfaces are usable. This fails when preview routing regresses or the state-first workbench loses a primary control.

Previews IconButton, a ControlBase-derived control, in a real browser and requires every specimen to render. A control that throws during render - the class of defect that bundler-injected environment reads cause, which jsdom and vite-node cannot reproduce because they materialize import.meta.env - leaves this gallery short of ready.
Opens the seeded StatusBadge workbench at a narrow phone viewport and proves its compact Appearance, Viewport, canvas, and selected-state controls remain usable without a separate playground mode.
Opens the persistent main-actions launcher at the catalog root and verifies that guided extract, adoption, and component-creation actions are all reachable before any workflow is started.
